name: epqpl-pm-system-docs
description: Document generators for the EPQPL cell-based PM system. Only needed to REGENERATE the Word files and the licence deck - the built copies are committed in docs/, so you do not need Node.js to use this project.

scripts.docs: node tools/build_docx.js BUILD.md docs/BUILD.docx && node tools/build_docx.js docs/HANDOVER.md && node tools/build_docx.js docs/STEP_BY_STEP_GUIDE.md
